page.overview:
Who is Tiffany Lords?

Tiffany is described as a cheerful and bubble-headed "American funky girl" who is very much into fashion and love life. She's always in a haze and playing around, without any thought of what lies ahead of her in the future. On weekends, she never misses the chance to go to the dance club. She misses her parents back in the United States, who in turn never forget to call her on the phone or send her presents every now and then. She and Roy attended the same school before they went overseas and she is in love with him.

In the School Life Mode of Nekketsu Seisyun Nikki 2, Tiffany shows more of her playful and whimsical side during the school events and she was also shown to have a little crush towards the male edit characters besides Roy while showing her bashfulness. Like Batsu, Tiffany is also shown to be quite very clumsy during the Swimming Day, where she was completely embarrassed after her own bikini top was accidentally removed via going down a water slide and splashing into the water itself.

Tiffany has long and curly blonde hair which is tied in a ponytail with a long distinctive curly fringe in the center of her head. In the original game, she wears red boxing gloves, a blue high-neck cheerleading suit with a big white star on the chest with two brown belts that attached on both of her shoulders, red and white stockings with golden stars on her folded stocking and blue boots.

As Tiffany2, she wears her Pacific school uniform; a blue formal suit jacket with a Pacific logo at the left side, a white long sleeve button shirt with a red tie at the collar, white skirt, brown stockings and black flats. In both Roy's and Boman's individual endings from within Rival Schools: United by Fate, as well as the Pacific High ending in Project Justice, she wears this outfit as her long neck tie is replaced with a salmon pink tie.
